svg.text: critical path: the longest chain of open tasks to M1-FU (10 tasks)
Colours are the Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe palette; tasks far apart may share one.
Arrows point from dependency to dependent. Transitive arrows (A to C when A to B to C exists) are not drawn:
Also not drawn: 136 dependencies on done or dropped tasks, 1 on a whole milestone.
